propositions: The workflow editor must expose an immutable read-only Effective Policy view derived from CriteriaSnapshot that reflects built-ins plus project overlays, separate from the editable Authored Workflow YAML/BPMN topology.
Project code-review LLM criteria with missing, empty, or blank applies_to glob lists must be rejected at save with actionable remediation; repository-wide coverage requires explicit ["**"] selector.

Effective Policy view displays criterion provenance including digest, source, gate, tier, posture, applicability, and enabled/disabled state without mutating or serializing changes back to workflow or project routing.
Built-in secondary triggers, project DET selector controls, and plan-review authoring rules retain their distinct trigger semantics and are exempt from the applies_to glob validation requirement.
Snapshot load or validation failures must mark the Effective Policy view unavailable with a located error message and prevent invalid saves; packaged defaults must not be silently substituted.
Editor payloads and responses must not contain execution trace detail, per-call debugging state, raw prompts, provider responses, or secrets.
